'''T. Alvak''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogator]]. Raised in a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] family, Alvak desired to be a pilot from an early age. Enrolling in the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]], Alvak graduated as a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] and served with the [[98th "Laser Storm" Forward Observer Shuttle Wing]] for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. After studying to be a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE starfighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]], he fought during the [[Solaest Uprising]], earning a promotion to [[Flight Captain]] and the [[Distinguished Flight Medal/Legends|Distinguished Flight Medal]]. Alvak later served with the [[Solaest Fleet Long Range Patrol Wing]].

==Biography==
[[File:Prefsbelt_Academy.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Alvak attended the Imperial Naval Academy on Prefsbelt IV.]]
T. Alvak was raised in a [[Navy/Legends|Naval]] family; his [[T. Alvak's father|father]] was a career [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who had served in a variety of postings, including tours as a sub-[[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] on [[Starship/Legends|starships]], a [[harbor controller]], and as the senior [[Portmaster/Legends|portmaster]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial base (Tieos)|base]] on<ref name="SWS2nd" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]]<ref name="SWS2nd" /> in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tieos system/Legends|Tieos system]]</ref> From an early age, Alvak wanted to [[Pilot/Legends|fly]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and was educated as a general [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]]. He enlisted in the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] on<ref name="SWS2nd" /> the planet<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] and qualified as a navigator. Graduating with honors in the top third of his class, Alvak was assigned to the [[98th "Laser Storm" Forward Observer Shuttle Wing]], serving as both an [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogator]] and emergency pilot. Two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, he was advanced to [[Flight leader/Legends|Flight Leader]] upon completion of his solo astrogation trials by the [[promotion board]].<ref name="SWS2nd" />

After serving with the 98th for a further two years, Alvak was transferred to the<ref name="SWS2nd" /> [[TIE training school]]<ref name="SWS1st">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> based on the<ref name="SWS2nd" /> [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|102|Inflexible}}</ref> ''[[Inflexible]]''. Qualifying in a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], Alvak was part of the Imperial response to the [[Solaest Uprising]] and was awarded the [[Distinguished Flight Medal/Legends|Distinguished Flight Medal]] for his actions during the campaign, along with a promotion to [[Flight Captain]]. He continued his career with the [[Solaest Fleet Long Range Patrol Wing]].<ref name="SWS2nd" />

==Personality and traits==
Alvak was considered to be a model [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], dedicated to the Imperial Navy and proud of his role within the institution. Upon graduation, Alvak swore an oath to defend the Empire and obey the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], and he upheld that vow with great seriousness. His superior officers found Alvak to be competent and reliable, although they occasionally felt that he was a little disrespectful of their authority. Alvak's peers considered him to be intelligent and quick-witted with the uncanny ability to be able to locate a store of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] anywhere. His subordinates found him to be a thoughtful yet remote and demanding [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="SWS2nd" />

==Skills and abilities==
Alvak was a skilled starfighter pilot and astrogator and was educated as a general engineer. He was a distinguished [[TIE pilot|TIE fighter pilot]], having learned how to fly one at the TIE training school on the ''Inflexible'' and earning the Distinguished Flight Medal for his performance flying one during the Solaest Uprising.<ref name="SWS2nd" />

==Equipment==
Alvak wore a TIE pilot's [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWS2nd" />

==Behind the scenes==
T. Alvak was first mentioned in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1987]]. His [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] statistics were used as an example of a typical Imperial TIE fighter pilot and he was noted as attending the "TIE training school" aboard the Star Destroyer ''Inflexible''.<ref name="SWS1st" /> In [[1994]], an updated [[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|edition]] of the sourcebook was released, in which Alvak's entry changed "TIE training school" to "Tir training school".<ref name="SWS2nd" /> This article assumes that the latter information is an error.
